title: saveCookie
description: Save browser cookies to a file.

anyOf.title: Save all cookies (simple)
anyOf.description: File path to save cookies to.

path.description: File path to save cookies to, relative to `directory`. If not specified, the file name is the ID of the step with a `.json` extension.

directory.description: Directory to save the cookie file. If the directory doesn't exist, creates the directory.

name.description: Name of a specific cookie to save. If not specified, saves all cookies for the current domain.

domain.description: Domain to save cookies from. If not specified, uses the current page's domain.

overwrite.description: If `true`, overwrites the existing file at `path` if it exists.
